scripts.build:server: esbuild backend/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --sourcemap --define:IS_PRODUCTION_BUILD=true --outfile=dist/server.js && esbuild backend/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --define:IS_PRODUCTION_BUILD=true --outfile=dist/server.cjs && esbuild backend/vercelHandler.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=api/index.js && cp api/index.js api/[...slug].js
scripts.prestart: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist/server.js') || !fs.existsSync('dist/server.cjs')) { console.log('[Server] Auto-building production server bundles...'); require('child_process').execSync('npm run build:server', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }" 2>/dev/null || true
